serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Landlord.Face.normal
Landlord: Huh? Back already?
You: Yes. Unfortunately I wasn’t able to kick these homeless people out.
Landlord: Now you understand. Things aren’t as simple as you would think! 
Landlord: Oh, yes, it will take some time to get to the island. A lot of time perhaps. 
This is so weird. When he was asking for money he seemed eager to leave. Did something change? 
You: Is there really no way to speed things up? 
Landlord: Getting homeless people to leave isn’t that easy, you should know this by now!
Landlord: I know that it was too much to ask you to do something at that level, but maybe you learned something important about that group. It could be useful.
You: They seem highly organized. They have some political manifesto and whatnot. 
Landlord: That’s just a bunch of nonsense! Is that all you learned?! God, you really are useless!
You: The hobo I spoke to also said something about a steam boiler and heat coming out the vents outside.
#Landlord.Face.Unhappy
Landlord: These maggots! They are stealing the heat I paid for!
You: No, the steam would leave the vents either way, I wouldn’t call that ‘stealing’.
Landlord: It doesn’t matter! They are profiting from something I pay for without my permission! I will teach them a lesson!
Landlord: Should I put spikes around those vents? 
Landlord: No, it would cost money.
Landlord: Should I just throw a bunch of homemade caltrops into the alleyway again?
Landlord: No, I can’t. The police are already onto me.
#Landlord.Face.Grin
Landlord: Oh! Here’s a good idea, buahahahaha!
Landlord: I still have some of the chemicals that are used for checking for the leaks in the boiler room! They smell awful which makes finding the leaks easier, but if we add a little more of them- no, much more of them to the boiler, these homeless people are gonna start gagging and will be forced to run away! I’m a genius! 
#Landlord.Face.Unhappy
You: Won’t that be dangerous for the homeless and people living there?
Landlord: I can’t believe you said that. It’s almost like you think it’s my problem.
You: …
#Landlord.Face.Grin
Landlord: Don’t be so gloomy! Maybe you didn’t kick them out by yourself, but you helped in finding a solution! 
You: That’s the part I’m concerned about…
Landlord: Anyway, I have a boiler room to visit. 
Landlord: After this is finished I will have another task for you. See you later.
